# Luban llms.txt

> Luban is a game configuration pipeline: Schema → Data → Generate → Runtime (Tables).

Official docs: https://www.datable.cn/docs/intro
Source: https://github.com/focus-creative-games/luban
Examples: https://github.com/focus-creative-games/luban_examples

## Core rules for agents

1. Schema is a contract. Do not silently change schema to make bad data pass.
2. Register tables in `__tables__` (or XML) before Excel files are collected.
3. Excel sheets are ignored unless A1 starts with `##`.
4. Groups: `c`=client, `s`=server, `e`=editor. Empty group usually means all default groups.
5. Prefer `Tables` aggregate loader at runtime; avoid per-table static singletons.
6. Publish pipelines should use `--strict`.
7. For machine-readable errors use `--errorFormat json`.
8. For machine-readable schema use `-c schema-json`.
